title: Tenure Reduction of the Late-Fee Percentage for Long-Paying Borrowers
content:
On Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts, the late-fee percentage applied to the monthly payment is lowered by a tenure reduction, in percentage points, set by the installments paid on the contract.

**Installments paid** are counted as the contract's scheduled-installment payments on the loan history less its returned payments on the loan history.

## Reduction schedule

| Installments paid on the contract | Tenure reduction |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | long-tenure late-fee reduction: 1.0 percentage point |
| 12 to 23 | mid-tenure late-fee reduction: 0.5 percentage point |
| fewer than 12 | no reduction |

The reduction is taken off the percentage itself, before the percentage is applied to the monthly payment.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical counts)

| Scheduled-installment payments | Returned payments | Installments paid | Reduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 24 | 0 | 24 | 1.0 point |
| 25 | 2 | 23 | 0.5 point |
| 12 | 0 | 12 | 0.5 point |
| 13 | 2 | 11 | none |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A percentage of 5.5 with 30 installments paid becomes 4.5 percent; on a monthly payment of 400.00 that is 18.00. With 15 installments paid it becomes 5.0 percent, that is 20.00.
